title: The Algebra of the Random Approximate Map Model
description: Final version (October 2026), with errata; superseded by the monograph Bernoulli Types: Two-Sided Error in Approximate Membership, Retrieval, and Computation, Chapter 9. The Bernoulli map, a probabilistic function generalizing Bernoulli sets to arbitrary codomains, with model order, closed-form marginal rates under composition (element-wise independence holds only without shared intermediate values), and a seed-search construction approaching -log2(epsilon)+mu bits per element.
